body:
This helps us better understand how many appenders are created per second. There is already prometheus_tsdb_head_active_appenders but it's a gauge, so it only shows active ones. There's also prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total, but that counts samples. This new counter adds a different view - how many appenders are created per second, combined with prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total we get average samples per append.
